provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

self_consistent_model: For positive constituent conductivities use the unique positive solution sigma of f*(sigma1-sigma)/(sigma1+2*sigma)+(1-f)*(sigma2-sigma)/(sigma2+2*sigma)=0. This is the three-dimensional isotropic spherical Bruggeman effective-medium approximation, not an exact microstructure solution.
limit_policy: For the separate ideal-insulator question take sigma2->0 from positive values at fixed sigma1. The effective conductivity tends to0 below the model threshold and is positive above it. Do not insert sigma=0 into the original rational expression and cancel an undefined denominator.
scope: Conditional effective-medium and high-contrast limit predictions; not a proof of a real geometric percolation threshold or of isotropic connectivity for an arbitrary composite.
